Argentina U17 2 (0) * Club domestic league appearances and goals as of 18:52, 17 March 2026 (UTC) Franco Sebastián Cristaldo (born 15 August 1996) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays mainly as an attacking midfielder for Talleres . Club career [ edit ] Born in Morón, Buenos Aires , Cristaldo was a Boca Juniors youth graduate. On 16 November 2014, he made his first team debut, coming on as a second-half substitute for Luciano Acosta in a 1–1 away draw against Arsenal de Sarandí . [ 1 ] Cristaldo was definitely promoted to the main squad in January 2015 by manager Rodolfo Arruabarrena . He scored his first professional goal on 29 March, netting the last in a 3–0 home win against Estudiantes de la Plata . [ 2 ] On 11 January 2016, Cristaldo joined Elche CF in Segunda División , on loan until the end of the season .
